Note: Conservative draft containing only entries with high confidence. Expand after source verification.

Items.Name: Gajakesari Yoga
Items.Description: Traditionally formed when Jupiter occupies a Kendra (1st, 4th, 7th or 10th house) from the Moon.
Items.Impact: Traditionally associated with wisdom, reputation, learning and prosperity. Actual results depend on the complete horoscope, planetary dignity, aspects and dasha.

Items.Name: Budha-Aditya Yoga
Items.Description: Traditionally formed by the conjunction of the Sun and Mercury.
Items.Impact: Traditionally associated with intellect, communication and administrative ability. Results depend on Mercury's dignity and afflictions.

Items.Name: Chandra-Mangala Yoga
Items.Description: Traditionally formed when the Moon and Mars are in conjunction or mutually aspect each other.
Items.Impact: Traditionally associated with enterprise and financial initiative.

Items.Name: Kemadruma Yoga
Items.Description: Traditionally formed when no qualifying planets occupy the 2nd and 12th from the Moon, subject to cancellation rules.
Items.Impact: Traditionally associated with emotional and material challenges. Cancellation rules must always be checked.

Items.Name: Ruchaka Yoga
Items.Description: Mars in own or exaltation sign in a Kendra from the Ascendant.
Items.Impact: Traditionally associated with courage, authority and leadership.

Items.Name: Bhadra Yoga
Items.Description: Mercury in own or exaltation sign in a Kendra from the Ascendant.
Items.Impact: Traditionally associated with intelligence, eloquence and analytical ability.

Items.Name: Hamsa Yoga
Items.Description: Jupiter in own or exaltation sign in a Kendra from the Ascendant.
Items.Impact: Traditionally associated with wisdom, spirituality and respect.

Items.Name: Malavya Yoga
Items.Description: Venus in own or exaltation sign in a Kendra from the Ascendant.
Items.Impact: Traditionally associated with comforts, beauty and artistic ability.

Items.Name: Sasa Yoga
Items.Description: Saturn in own or exaltation sign in a Kendra from the Ascendant.
Items.Impact: Traditionally associated with discipline, endurance and authority.

Items.Name: Viparita Raja Yoga
Items.Description: Traditionally formed through specific relationships among the lords of the 6th, 8th and 12th houses.
Items.Impact: Traditionally associated with success emerging through adversity when classical conditions are satisfied.

Items.Name: Neechabhanga Raja Yoga
Items.Description: Traditional cancellation of planetary debilitation according to classical rules.
Items.Impact: Traditionally associated with recovery from setbacks and eventual rise.

Items.Name: Parivartana Yoga
Items.Description: Exchange of signs between two planetary lords.
Items.Impact: Results depend on the houses, planets and dignity involved.

Items.Name: Kendra-Trikona Raja Yoga
Items.Description: Formed when a lord of a Kendra house associates with a lord of a Trikona house through conjunction, mutual aspect or exchange.
Items.Impact: Traditionally associated with rise, authority, fortune and capacity for accomplishment. Strength depends on dignity, combustion, house placement and supporting or afflicting influences.

Items.Name: Lakshmi Yoga
Items.Description: Traditional combination involving strong fortune and trinal lords.
Items.Impact: Traditionally associated with prosperity and good fortune.

Items.Name: Saraswati Yoga
Items.Description: Traditional combination involving Jupiter, Venus and Mercury under favourable conditions.
Items.Impact: Traditionally associated with learning, knowledge and eloquence.

Items.Name: Adhi Yoga
Items.Description: Benefic planets occupying the 6th, 7th and/or 8th from the Moon under classical rules.
Items.Impact: Traditionally associated with status, comfort and respect.

Items.Name: Shubha Kartari Yoga
Items.Description: A house or planet hemmed between benefic planets.
Items.Impact: Traditionally strengthens the protected house or planet.

Items.Name: Papa Kartari Yoga
Items.Description: A house or planet hemmed between malefic planets.
Items.Impact: Traditionally weakens the affected house or planet.

Items.Name: Durdhara Yoga
Items.Description: Qualifying planets on both sides of the Moon according to classical rules.
Items.Impact: Traditionally associated with stability and support.

Items.Name: Amala Yoga
Items.Description: A benefic planet in the 10th from the Ascendant or Moon.
Items.Impact: Traditionally associated with reputation and righteous conduct.

Items.Name: Shakata Yoga
Items.Description: Traditionally formed when Jupiter is in the 6th or 8th from the Moon.
Items.Impact: Traditionally associated with fluctuations in fortune.
